description: This file defines the MlflowLogger class, which integrates MLflow tracking with custom logging for handling success, failure, and streaming events related to machine learning inference. It utilizes MLflow's tracking API to start and end spans/traces, attach attributes, and log events, specifically targeting MLflow's tracing capabilities for model call monitoring within the litellm project.

classes.name: MlflowLogger
classes.description: A logger class that integrates MLflow tracking with custom logging, providing methods to log success and failure events, handle streaming, and manage MLflow spans/traces for model inference monitoring.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes an MlflowLogger instance with an MLflow client, internal span mapping, and threading lock.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles logging of successful inference events.

methods.name: _handle_success(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Core logic for processing a successful inference event, including span creation and attribute extraction.

methods.name: _extract_and_set_chat_attributes(self, span, kwargs, response_obj)
methods.description: Extracts chat message attributes from responses and sets them in the span for traceability.

methods.name: log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles logging of failed inference events.

methods.name: _handle_failure(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Core logic for processing a failure event, including span creation, error logging, and span ending.

methods.name: _handle_stream_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles logging for streaming responses, creating a span for the entire stream and adding chunk events.

methods.name: _add_chunk_events(self, span, response_obj)
methods.description: Adds streaming chunk messages as events to the span.

methods.name: _construct_input(self, kwargs)
methods.description: Builds input parameters for span creation based on the event kwargs.

methods.name: _extract_attributes(self, kwargs)
methods.description: Extracts and constructs span attributes from event kwargs, including optional standard logging object data.

methods.name: str _get_span_type(self, call_type: Optional[str])
methods.description: Determines span type based on call type.

methods.name: _start_span_or_trace(self, kwargs, start_time)
methods.description: Starts an MLflow span or trace, linked to an active span if available.

methods.name: dict _transform_tag_list_to_dict(self, tag_list: list)
methods.description: Converts a list of colon-separated tags into a dictionary format.

methods.name: _end_span_or_trace(self, span, outputs, end_time_ns, status)
methods.description: Ends the current span or trace with provided outputs, status, and timestamp.
